title: Frame-rate DPR governor and an idle render gate
variants: Three.js: half-second fps windows step setPixelRatio by .25 inside the probe's clamp, loop off the shared ticker 1.5 s after the last input (this, default)
Target-fps tier object: per-tier DPR range and target fps instead of fixed 45 / 57 thresholds
R3F: <Canvas frameloop="demand"> with invalidate() on input for the gate, and setDpr from a PerformanceMonitor-style callback for the governor
